sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The gameplay of Multi-player Pong - 2 players revolves around a simple yet engaging mechanic. Players take turns hitting a ball back and forth on a rectangular court, with the objective of making the ball land in the opponent's goal. The first player to score three points wins the game. The simple controls and intuitive gameplay make it easy for players to pick up and start playing immediately.

The gameplay is divided into two phases - the serve and the rally. During the serve, one player starts by hitting the ball to their opponent, who then tries to return it. The rally phase begins when the opponent returns the serve, and players continue to hit the ball back and forth until one of them fails to return it or makes an error. The game's pace is relatively fast, making it exciting and thrilling to play.

One notable aspect of the game's core mechanics is its use of a fixed ball velocity. This means that the ball travels at a consistent speed, making it easier for players to anticipate and react to its trajectory. However, this also means that players need to focus on precise timing and positioning to make successful shots. Overall, the game's core mechanics are well-designed, making it enjoyable and challenging for players of all skill levels.

Once you've mastered the basics of Multi-player Pong - 2 players, it's time to move on to advanced strategies.
